name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
description: A staff of grey wood forked at the top like a lightning bolt.
body:
## What it does

It fights as a magic quarterstaff that strikes truer and harder than a plain one. Each of its powers works once a day: lightning on a hit, thunder on a hit, a bolt of lightning, a thunderclap, or both at once.

damage.note: once per dawn, when you call lightning on a hit

features.name: Thunder
features.text: Once per dawn, on a hit, the target makes a DC 17 Constitution save or is stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.text: Once per dawn, a 120-foot line of lightning, 5 feet wide; each creature in it makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 9d6 lightning damage on a failure and half on a success.

features.name: Thunderclap
features.text: Once per dawn, each creature within 60 feet makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 2d6 thunder damage and deafened for a minute on a failure, half and not deafened on a success.

features.name: Thunder and Lightning
features.text: Once per dawn, use the strike and the thunderclap at once, without spending their own daily uses.
